laws.rule: Kopaonik National Park charges a vehicle fee at the Đorov Bridge, Brzeće and Sunčana Dolina gates: cars and motorcycles RSD 300 a day, RSD 800 a week, RSD 2,000 a year. Hybrid and electric vehicles are exempt but must send registration proof within 8 days of first entry or the invoice stands. (No RBA rate for RSD)
laws.heading: Kopaonik vehicle fee
